pertanyaan: The warden ... the new inmates every Monday morning.
pembahasan: Simple present untuk kebiasaan (every Monday); subjek tunggal "The warden" memerlukan verb + s.
sumber: Tata bahasa Inggris baku (cakupan menurut Rangkuman Ujian Dinas & UPKP (sumber/Rangkuman_Ujian_Dinas_UPKP_dan_ORTALA_Kemenimipas.md) §B.4)

pertanyaan: Look! The officers ... the visitors' bags at the gate right now.
pembahasan: "Look!" dan "right now" menandai present continuous: am/is/are + V-ing.

pertanyaan: Our team ... the monthly report since early this morning, and it is still not finished.
pembahasan: Present perfect continuous (has/have been + V-ing) untuk aktivitas yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung (since ..., still not finished).

pertanyaan: By the time the inspector arrived, the staff ... all the documents.
pembahasan: Past perfect (had + V3) untuk tindakan yang selesai sebelum tindakan lampau lain (arrived).

pertanyaan: I ... in the immigration office for five years before I moved to the correctional institution.
pembahasan: Kejadian yang berlangsung sebelum kejadian lampau lain (moved) memakai past perfect.

pertanyaan: This time tomorrow, the participants ... the computer-based test.
pembahasan: "This time tomorrow" menandai future continuous: will be + V-ing.

pertanyaan: By the end of next year, the ministry ... ten new service units.
pembahasan: "By the end of next year" menandai future perfect: will have + V3.

pertanyaan: The head of the division ... to Jakarta last week for a coordination meeting.
pembahasan: "Last week" menandai simple past; bentuk lampau go adalah went.

pertanyaan: While the officer ... the visitor's identity card, the power suddenly went out.
pembahasan: Past continuous (was/were + V-ing) untuk tindakan yang sedang berlangsung ketika tindakan lain (went out) terjadi.

pertanyaan: She ... her master's degree yet, so she cannot apply for the rank adjustment.
pembahasan: "Yet" lazim dengan present perfect: has/have + not + V3.

pertanyaan: The officer ... helped the elderly visitor received an award.
pembahasan: "Who" menggantikan subjek orang (the officer) dalam adjective clause.

pertanyaan: The applicant ... passport was lost reported it to the police.
pembahasan: "Whose" menyatakan kepemilikan (passport milik applicant).

pertanyaan: The supervisor ... we interviewed yesterday has worked here for twenty years.
pembahasan: "Whom" menggantikan objek orang (we interviewed him).

pertanyaan: The application ... we use for online visits is easy to operate.
pembahasan: "Which" menggantikan benda (the application).

pertanyaan: The building ... the training center is located was renovated last year.
pembahasan: "Where" dipakai untuk keterangan tempat (in which the training center is located).

pertanyaan: The report ... by the internal audit team was submitted to the minister.
pembahasan: Reduced adjective clause bentuk pasif: "which was prepared" diringkas menjadi "prepared".

pertanyaan: Employees ... in the morning shift must sign the attendance list before 7 a.m.
pembahasan: Reduced adjective clause bentuk aktif: "who work" diringkas menjadi "working".

pertanyaan: The word "enhance" in "The ministry aims to enhance public services" is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Enhance berarti meningkatkan/memperbaiki, sinonim improve.

pertanyaan: The word "require" in "The regulation requires all officers to report their assets" is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Require bermakna mewajibkan, sinonim oblige.

pertanyaan: The word "meticulous" in "She is meticulous in checking every document" is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Meticulous berarti sangat teliti, sinonim careful.

pertanyaan: The word "commence" in "The examination will commence at 8 a.m." is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Commence berarti mulai, sinonim begin.

pertanyaan: The word "adequate" in "The prison has adequate medical facilities" is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Adequate berarti memadai, sinonim sufficient.

pertanyaan: The word "mitigate" in "The ministry plans to mitigate the risk of overcrowding" is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Mitigate berarti mengurangi/meredakan, sinonim lessen.

pertanyaan: The word "comply" in "All staff must comply with the code of ethics" is closest in meaning to ...
pembahasan: Comply with berarti mematuhi, sinonim obey.

pertanyaan: The opposite (antonym) of "temporary" is ...
pembahasan: Temporary berarti sementara; antonimnya permanent. Pilihan lain bermakna mirip temporary.

pertanyaan: Neither the director nor the staff members ... available yesterday.
pembahasan: Pada neither ... nor, kata kerja mengikuti subjek terdekat (the staff members, jamak) → were.

pertanyaan: The visitors were asked ... their mobile phones at the front desk.
pembahasan: Pola ask someone to + V1: "were asked to leave".

pertanyaan: The officers avoided ... any personal information to strangers.
pembahasan: Avoid diikuti gerund (V-ing).

pertanyaan: If the system were working properly, the queue ... so long.
pembahasan: Conditional tipe 2 (keadaan tidak nyata saat ini): If + past (were), would + V1.

pertanyaan: If the officer had checked the document carefully, the mistake ...
pembahasan: Conditional tipe 3: If + had V3, would have + V3 (pasif: would have been V3).

pertanyaan: The new regulation ... by the minister last month.
pembahasan: Kalimat pasif bentuk lampau: was/were + V3.

pertanyaan: This year's service index is ... than last year's.
pembahasan: Comparative adjektiva satu suku kata: high → higher than.

pertanyaan: ... the heavy rain, the morning roll call was held as scheduled.
pembahasan: Despite diikuti frasa benda (the heavy rain); although diikuti klausa.

pertanyaan: Identify the incorrect part: "Each of the officers have to submit a performance report every month."
pembahasan: Each of + jamak tetap dianggap tunggal, sehingga kata kerjanya has, bukan have.

pertanyaan: Identify the incorrect part: "The informations about the visiting schedule is available on the website."
pembahasan: Information adalah uncountable noun sehingga tidak diberi -s.

pertanyaan: Identify the incorrect part: "The inmates who completed the training was given certificates by the head of the prison."
pembahasan: Subjek "The inmates" jamak sehingga kata kerja pasifnya were given.

pertanyaan: Identify the incorrect part: "She has worked in this office since five years."
pembahasan: Durasi waktu (five years) memakai for; since dipakai untuk titik waktu.

pertanyaan: Read the text: "Online visiting services allow families to meet inmates through video calls. The service reduces queues at the gate and helps families who live far away." What is the main idea of the text?

opsi.A: Queues at the gate cannot be reduced by any new service at all.
opsi.B: Inmates prefer letters to video calls.
opsi.C: Families must still visit inmates in person to use video calls.
opsi.D: Online visiting services benefit both the institution and families.
opsi.E: Video calls are too expensive for families.

pembahasan: Teks menjelaskan dua manfaat layanan kunjungan daring: mengurangi antrean dan membantu keluarga yang jauh.

pertanyaan: Read the text: "Before boarding, every passenger must pass through immigration control. Officers check the passport and may ask about the purpose of travel." According to the text, what may officers ask?
pembahasan: Teks menyebut petugas dapat menanyakan purpose of travel (tujuan perjalanan).

pertanyaan: Read the text: "Overcrowding remains a serious challenge. When cells hold more people than their capacity, health risks increase and rehabilitation programs become less effective." The word "capacity" refers to ...

opsi.A: the number of rehabilitation programs offered in each cell block
opsi.B: the maximum number of people a cell is designed to hold
opsi.C: the length of a prison sentence
opsi.D: the total cost of building and maintaining a new prison cell
opsi.E: the number of officers on duty

pembahasan: Capacity dalam konteks ini adalah daya tampung maksimal sel.

pertanyaan: Read the text: "Overcrowding remains a serious challenge. When cells hold more people than their capacity, health risks increase and rehabilitation programs become less effective." It can be inferred from the text that reducing overcrowding would ...

opsi.A: stop all rehabilitation programs until capacity is increased
opsi.C: increase health risks for inmates and officers in every cell

pembahasan: Jika overcrowding menurunkan efektivitas program, maka menguranginya akan membuat program lebih efektif (inferensi).

pertanyaan: Read the text: "The training lasted three days. On the first day, participants learned about ethics; on the second, public service; and on the last day, they took a test." What did participants do on the third day?
pembahasan: Teks: "on the last day, they took a test"; pelatihan berlangsung tiga hari sehingga hari ketiga adalah hari terakhir.
